gloss: major technique; big move; bold feat

definitions.gloss: major technique; big move; powerful maneuver
definitions.explanation: A large, impressive, or difficult technique in martial arts, sports, or performance. Also used figuratively for bold, dramatic actions.

examples.japanese: {大技|おおわざ}が{決|き}まった。
{大技|おおわざ}を{繰|く}り{出|だ}して{逆転|ぎゃくてん}した。
examples.english: They pulled off a major move and turned things around.

examples.japanese: {大技|おおわざ}は{失敗|しっぱい}すると{大|おお}きなリスクが{伴|ともな}うが、{成功|せいこう}すれば{一気|いっき}に{形勢|けいせい}が{変|か}わる。
examples.english: Big moves carry great risk if they fail, but if they succeed, they can change the situation in an instant.

notes:
USAGE:
Originating from martial arts and sumo, now widely used in sports commentary and figuratively for bold actions. Contrasts with {小技|こわざ} (small technique, subtle move).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大技|おおわざ}を{繰|く}り{出|だ}す (to pull off a big move)
- {大技|おおわざ}が{決|き}まる (a big move lands/succeeds)
- {大技|おおわざ}に{挑|いど}む (to attempt a major technique)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小技|こわざ}: small technique, subtle move — the opposite
- {必殺技|ひっさつわざ}: finishing move, killer technique — implies a decisive blow
